message.content:
I don’t have access to live data feeds, so I can’t give you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and view the current AQI, pollutant breakdown, and health advisories. |
| **AQICN** | Go to https://aqicn.org/, search for “Los Angeles”, and see the real‑time index and forecast. |
| **Local news sites** | Many LA news outlets (e.g., LA Times, KABC) publish daily air‑quality updates. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps like “Plume Labs: Air Report” or “EPA AirNow” provide push notifications for AQI changes. |

If you’re looking for historical trends or a deeper analysis, let me know and I can help pull in some recent data or explain how to interpret the numbers.
